This page explains what personal information we collect through this website, why, and what you can do about it. We keep it short and plain.

1. Who we are

This website belongs to Limitless Goals Import & Export Services, United Arab Emirates. We decide how your information is used, so we are responsible for it (the "controller"). Contact us about privacy at info@limitlessgoals.ae or +971 54 779 9003.

Our website was built by Web Smith FZCO.

2. What we collect

  • When you send our contact form: your name, email, phone number and your message. Please don't put sensitive details in the form (such as health, financial or ID information).
  • When you tap WhatsApp or Call: the button opens WhatsApp or your phone app. We then see your number and whatever you send us, like any other chat or call. WhatsApp is run by Meta under its own privacy policy.
  • Our hosting provider automatically keeps short technical logs (such as IP address and browser type) to keep the site secure and working.

We don't sell your information, and we don't use it for advertising profiles.

3. Why we use it, and on what basis

What we doWhyLegal basis (UAE PDPL)
Reply to your enquiry, give you a quote or book you inBecause you asked us toYour consent when you send the form (Art. 4 and 6), and steps you asked for before a possible agreement with us (Art. 4(9))
Keep records if you become a customerTo serve you and meet our legal duties (tax, accounting)Contract (Art. 4(9)) and legal obligations (Art. 4(10))
Security logsTo protect the site from misuseLegal obligations to keep data secure (Art. 20) and to defend legal claims (Art. 4(3))

We will only send you marketing messages if you clearly agree to them, and every message lets you stop them.

4. How long we keep it

  • Enquiries that don't lead to work: up to 12 months, then deleted.
  • Customers: as long as we work together, then as long as tax and accounting law requires.
  • Hosting security logs: usually a few weeks, set by our hosting provider.

5. Who we share it with

Only with the service providers we need to run this website, and only what they need:

  • Website hosting: GitHub, Inc. (GitHub Pages)
  • Email (where form messages arrive): Google Workspace
  • Form delivery: FormSubmit (formsubmit.co)

They may only use your information to provide their service to us. We may also share information if the law or a court or government authority requires it.

Outside the UAE: some of these providers store data outside the UAE (for example in the United States). Where they do, we rely on their contracts that require them to keep your information confident and secure and to use it only for us, as the UAE PDPL allows (Art. 22 and 23).

6. Your rights

Under the UAE PDPL you can ask us, free of charge, to:

  • tell you what information we hold about you, why, and who we share it with (Art. 13);
  • give you a copy in a common format, or send it to someone else (Art. 14);
  • correct it or delete it (Art. 15);
  • limit how we use it (Art. 16);
  • stop using it, including for marketing at any time (Art. 17);
  • withdraw your consent at any time. This doesn't affect what we did before you withdrew it (Art. 6).

How: email info@limitlessgoals.ae or WhatsApp +971 54 779 9003 with the subject "Privacy request". We may ask you to confirm who you are. We aim to reply within 30 days.

If you're not happy with our answer, you can complain to the UAE data protection authority (the UAE Data Office, whose role has moved to the UAE Artificial Intelligence and Data Authority) (Art. 24).

7. Cookies

This website doesn't use cookies to track you.

Opening the map or a WhatsApp link may let Google or Meta set their own cookies under their own policies.

8. Security

We use HTTPS on this site and limit who can read form messages. No website is 100% secure, but if a breach puts your information at risk, we will tell you and the authorities as the law requires (Art. 9).

9. Children

This website is not aimed at children. Please don't send us a child's information without a parent's or guardian's permission.

10. Changes

If we change this policy, we'll update the date at the top of this page.
